newsitem.title: PANAMA: Two earthquakes hit western Panama; no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Two earthquakes hit western Panama; no injuries.

text.p: Two earthquakes shook western Panama on Thursday, but there were no reports of injuries or damage.

The National Geoseismic Center said a first quake, measuring 4.6 on the open-ended Richter scale, struck at 7:04 a.m. (1204 GMT), with its epicenter about 40 miles (65 km) off Panama's western coast near the city of David.
A second quake, measuring 4.5 on the Richter scale, shook the same area at 1:37 p.m. (1837 GMT) near the Costa Rican border.
"The quakes were small. They caused some alarm but no damage," a National Geoseismic Center spokeswoman said.
